Drag Font size slider (critical)
State that changes affect only the user's own view
Fallback if restricted: Request captions, Send, host approval

fix: Change the last paragraph to: 'If nothing happens when you click **Show captions**, the host may have restricted them. Click **More**, then **Request captions**, then **Send**.
